conditions: distributed heights, surveyed geometry, precision observations only

results.name: ESP32 / CSI
results.assumptions: Source-derived 2D RTI on a ~15 cm grid. No camera, range, or depth observations.

results.name: ESP32 / hybrid
results.assumptions: Assumed range noise scale 25 cm; azimuth 0.7°; elevation 0.9°. Ideal single-target association and known sensor poses.

results.name: 3D mmWave
results.assumptions: Each visible radar supplies an associated XYZ point with 12 cm noise scale per axis. Demonstration cones: 120° × 40°; capped at 8 m.

results.name: UWB / tagged
results.trackedObject: A worn or attached UWB tag
results.assumptions: Assumed 10 cm line-of-sight range noise; 1 mm numeric quantization. Four noncoplanar visible anchors are needed for range-only Z.

results.name: Depth + mmWave
results.assumptions: Optical point noise scale = 10 mm + 4 mm × distance² (meters); optical range 0.6–4 m. Point noise is isotropic in this simplified model. Radar XYZ noise scale 12 cm.

results.name: Optical / reference
results.trackedObject: A reflective marker or rigid marker cluster
results.assumptions: Assumed 0.02° azimuth/elevation noise; 2 mm camera residual floor; 8 m demo optical cutoff; 65° × 51° wide lenses.
